name: Enforce Authentic 1-Bit System 7 Aesthetics
description: Checks UI and graphics components on save to ensure crisp 1-bit rendering without blurry shadows or modern gradients.

action.prompt: Review the saved UI or graphics file against .kiro/steering/tech.md: Ensure canvas elements enforce pixelated rendering, disallow blurry CSS box-shadows or gradients, and verify that visual transitions use the pixel buffer engine (Galois LFSR dissolve) rather than CSS opacity transitions.
